title: Low-degree Fourier weight and noise stability
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Then $3^{-k}$ times the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over subsets of coordinates of size at most $k$ is at most the noise stability of $f$ at correlation $1/3$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
